page.overview:
What is Springfield?

Springfield is a small city or town (depending on the episode) in Springfield County, Springfield's State and is located within the continental United States, where the Simpson family lives. The name of the state it is located in has never been revealed, with episode-to-episode evidence being insufficient and contradictory.

The city population is estimated to be approximately 60,000. The zip code is 80085, per "Moe Letter Blues." The city has often been dubbed as the, or at a stretch, one of America's worst towns and called "America's Crud Bucket", "The Armpit of America's Butt-Crack", "The Little Town That Can't and Won't, "The World's Meanest City", as well as being the "World's Fattest Town" and the town with the lowest voter in America. It is one and a half times bigger than Alaska, with West Springfield the shape of Texas.

Founded and created in 1796 by Jebediah Springfield (an alias of pirate Hans Sprungfeld), and a band of fiercely determined pioneers left Maryland after misinterpreting a passage in the Bible, Springfield seems to be a small city rather than a megalopolis. Its features include one nuclear power plant; at least five elementary schools; a minor league all-star baseball stadium; an airport; a harbor; a downtown district; a large tire yard (burning since 1966); a ghetto; a Russian District; its own Little Italy; several specialized shopping districts, Moe's Tavern, Barney's Bowl-A-Rama and a Chinatown.

Springfield's nearest neighboring town is Shelbyville. There is a strong rivalry between the towns, dating back to the rivalry between their founders - Jebediah Springfield and Shelbyville Manhattan. Manhattan wanted to found a city where men were free to marry their cousins, but Springfield refused to allow it, so Shelbyville was founded as a rival town.
